recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5258 unless a separate work-group copyediting task chooses to polish the DetectedIssue introduction.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 clarification for the Contraindication resource asking to replace overbroad "any circumstance" wording with "various circumstances" because the resource has explicit non-use boundaries.
initial_application: Git commit f8d682fb952e8e9162cf3b23555a41b6d5e411cf, matching Jira's svn revision 4405 comment, changed source/contraindication/contraindication-introduction.xml from "any circumstance" to "various circumstances."
additional_context: FHIR-8043 later renamed Contraindication to DetectedIssue in commit 1408563d743f15eff785f59063b34b538b4d4651, and source/fhir.ini lists detectedissue as an active resource. The current source retains the material "various circumstances" wording and nearby boundary text. The Jira resolution's editorial plural "clinical activities" is not present, but the current wording plus the following sentence about single, proposed, and multiple actions preserves the same implementer-facing meaning.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source already corrects the overbroad "any" wording, and changing only singular/plural grammar would be editorial rather than necessary for current-spec correctness.
